description_en: Queries the Wi-Fi settings of a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-sag-wifi --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-whfn0000 --smart-ag-sn sag32a300000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSagWifi

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the SAG instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number (SN) of the SAG device
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: smart_ag_sn

AuthenticationType.description_en:
The authentication type. Valid values:

NONE: authentication is disabled.

WPA-PSK: WPA-PSK authentication is enabled.

WPA2-PSK: WPA2-PSK authentication is enabled
AuthenticationType.description_zh:
认证类型：

NONE：未开启认证。
WPA-PSK：开启WPA-PSK认证。
WPA2-PSK：开启WPA2-PSK认证

Bandwidth.description_en:
The bandwidth of the Wi-Fi channel. Valid values:

Automatic

20 HMz

40 MHz

EncryptAlgorithm.description_en:
The encryption algorithm.

AUTO: automatically selects the encryption algorithm.

TKIP: uses the Temporal Key Integrity Protocol (TKIP).

AES: uses the Advanced Encryption Standard authorized by Wi-Fi®
EncryptAlgorithm.description_zh:
加密算法：

AUTO：自动加密。
TKIP：临时密钥完整性协议。
AES：WiFi授权的高效加密标准

IsAuth.description_en:
Indicates whether wireless security is enabled.

True: wireless security is enabled.

False: wireless security is disabled
IsAuth.description_zh:
无线安全是否打开：

True：无线安全功能打开。
False：无线安全功能未打开

IsBroadcast.description_en:
Indicates whether broadcast over Wi-Fi is enabled. Valid values:

True: broadcast is enabled.

False: broadcast is disabled
IsBroadcast.description_zh:
Wifi广播功能是否打开：

True：Wifi广播功能打开。
False：Wifi广播功能未打开

IsEnable.description_en:
Indicates whether wireless connections are enabled. Valid values:

True: wireless connections are enabled.

False: wireless connections are disabled
IsEnable.description_zh:
无线功能是否开启：

True：是。
False：否

Ssid.description_en: The service set identifier (SSID) of the Wi-Fi network

TaskStates.description_en: The information about the query task

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the query task was created

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned for a query task. The 200 error code indicates that the query task is successful
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码。200标识查询任务成功

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned for a query task. The Successful error message indicates that the query task is successful
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 错误信息。Successful标识查询任务成功

State.description_en:
The status of the query task. Valid values:

Initialized: The query task has been initialized.

Offline: The query task is not dispatched because the SAG device is disconnected from Alibaba Cloud. The task will be dispatched after the SAG device is connected to Alibaba Cloud.

Succeed: The query task has been dispatched.

Processing: The query task is being dispatched.

VersionNotSupport: The current version of the SAG device does not support query tasks.

BuildRequestError: The SAG control system does not support query tasks.

HardwareError: The query task failed to be dispatched due to device errors.

TaskNotExist: The query task does not exist.

OfflineNotConfiged: The query task is not dispatched because the SAG device is disconnected from Alibaba Cloud. The task will not be dispatched after the device is connected to Alibaba Cloud
State.description_zh:
异步任务状态：

Initialized：查询任务初始化。
Offline：智能接入网关设备离线未下发查询任务，智能接入网关设备上线后会继续下发。
Succeed：查询任务下发成功。
Processing：查询任务下发中。
VersionNotSupport：智能接入网关设备当前版本不支持。
BuildRequestError：管控不支持。
HardwareError：由于设备原因查询任务下发失败。
TaskNotExist：查询任务不存在。
OfflineNotConfiged：智能接入网关设备离线未下发查询任务，智能接入网关设备上线后也不会下发
